verdict.rationale: Porkbun ships an official MCP server (npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server, 96 tools) that connects Claude, Cursor or any MCP client to the account. Users can then 'ask in plain language' to register domains, edit DNS, provision hosting and move zones. The docs give a concrete natural-language example ('Register skaboink.dev if it's under $20, point it at my server, and turn auto-renew on'), and a probe confirms the MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflow works as claimed, and a native in-product natural-language interface (it currently depends on a third-party AI client).
